name: Dome Gallery
rationale: Clean-room CSS 3D implementation from the one-line effect description only; no React Bits source was read, no WebGL or gesture library is needed, and touch-action: pan-y keeps vertical page scroll working on mobile.

radius.description: Sphere radius in px; also the perspective, so a facing tile shows at its natural size.

rows.description: Rows of tiles stacked up the dome.

step.description: Angle between neighbouring tiles, in degrees.

autoRotate.description: Idle drift in degrees per second; pauses on hover, focus and drag. 0 turns it off.

inertia.description: Keep turning briefly after a fast drag is released.

label.default: Gallery. Drag or use the arrow keys to look around.
label.description: Accessible name used when the host has no aria-label or aria-labelledby.

a11y: The host becomes a focusable role="group" with an accessible name; Arrow keys turn and tilt the dome and Home recentres it, giving keyboard parity with drag.
Moving focus onto a link or button inside a tile turns the dome to face that tile, so the focused element is always on screen.
Tiles facing away from the viewer only fade out (opacity and pointer-events), so their content stays in the accessibility tree and in DOM tab order.
Reduced motion never builds the dome: the tiles stay in a flat, horizontally scrollable strip with no drift, inertia or 3D transforms.
